name: Dana
label: Free-tier user resisting Premium
who: I've used the free tier with ads and skip limits, and I'm frustrated that basic features keep moving behind Premium ([2],[13]). I have upgraded before when a limit got too annoying, and I still weigh whether paying is worth it ([19],[21]).
value_for_money: Says the free tier is nearly unusable and pushes users toward Premium ([32],[19]); says they do not want to pay for Premium ([2]). Other posts in their feed say Premium is cheap at about 11.99 pounds or $12 a month ([37],[18]) and that 9.99 pounds is too much for light users ([8]).
loyalty: Stays on free Spotify because they can still listen with ads and would rather not pay ([2]); would consider Premium if features keep moving behind the paywall ([13]), or buy YouTube Premium instead ([25]).
pain_points: Can't choose songs on the free tier ([14])
Random shuffle and ads on free ([9])
likes: Choosing songs on desktop or tablet ([24])
reasons_to_stay: They say Premium removes third-party ads and that the desktop lets them pick songs on the free tier ([22],[24]). They stick around because they can still listen for free, and some say the price is fine for the music ([18],[37]).
tone: Blunt and sarcastic, with short jabs and casual slang.
